attributes.action: Ban UK sales of property in illegal Israeli settlements
attributes.additional_details: The UK recognises Israeli settlements as illegal under international law. We want legislation banning any UK marketing, sale or facilitation of property in these settlements. The UK already restricts land purchases linked to Russia’s illegal occupation; the same standard must apply consistently to all unlawful occupations.
attributes.background: The UK recognises Israeli settlements as illegal. We want a law banning any UK marketing, sale or facilitation of property in these settlements. The UK already bans land purchases linked to Russia’s occupation — this should be applied consistently.

rejection.details:
We can't publish petitions when the request is something that has been announced since you started your petition.

We think your petition is covered by Government or Parliament action already. If you'd like something else, you could start a new petition clearly explaining what it is.

On 8 September, the Government announced that it will ban advertising or promotion of land and property in illegal settlements. It said it will also take action on services, creating new designation powers to go after individuals and companies that support, facilitate or profit from illegal settlement activity. 

You can find out more here: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/ukto-bring-forward-new-powers-to-respond-to-moral-emergency-in-palestine-and-targetillegal-settlement-activity-in-the-west-bank-to-protect-the-viabili
